_doc: Layered stop criteria (user 2026-10-23). A skill is DONE when every gate in generic + its family + its task passes AND tracking fidelity has converged. Gates the decider adds while iterating go to the task scope (decision field stop_gates_add). Metrics: eval.* = best checkpoint's eval json; robust.* = robustness success rate (flip + the 5 s run past the reference); sim2sim.* = native MuJoCo success rate; critic.max_unwaived_severity = worst library check of the task after waivers (decision field waive: [{check, reason}]). value_ref may use ref_flight_s (reference flight duration). hold_* = the last 2 s of the reference (its final pose held, scripts/data/hold_tail.py), post_* = the 5 s recorded past the reference (eval_flip.py --post_s).

generic.why: user: stay stable >= 2 s after the motion; the reference must end with >= 2 s of its held final pose
no stepping / sliding in the final pose
user: 姿态好 - torso tilt vs the reference's final pose
mean joint error vs the reference's final pose
feet the reference keeps on the ground stay down
still up 5 s past the reference
no large unexplained deviation from the reference
pushes, friction, CoM, encoder bias, noise
control latency of a real robot

convergence.why: fidelity curriculum: stop tightening when the body tracking error stops improving

family:hand_support.why: the whole hand-supported rotation (relative to the reference's own rotation)
